description_en: Updates the information of a Managed Service for Prometheus instance
kebab_example: aliyun cms update-prometheus-instance --prometheus-instance-id rw-xxxxxxx --archive-duration 365 --auth-free-read-policy '{"SourceIp":["192.168.1.0/24","172.168.2.22"],"SourceVpc":["vpc-xx1","vpc-xx2"]}' --auth-free-write-policy '{"SourceIp":["192.168.1.0/24","172.168.2.22"],"SourceVpc":["vpc-xx1","vpc-xx2"]}' --enable-auth-free-read true --enable-auth-free-write true --enable-auth-token true --prometheus-instance-name test-prom-name --status RUNNING --storage-duration 90 --payment-type POSTPAY_GB --workspace default-cms-1500199863951574-cn-shanghai --api-version 2024-03-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePrometheusInstance

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for automatic archiving after storage expires. A value of 0 indicates no archiving. Valid values for archiving days:
V1: 1 to 365 days. Supported only for billing by metric write volume.
V2: 1 to 3650 days (3650 indicates permanent retention)
parameters.help_zh:
存储到期后，自动归档保存的天数，0表示不归档保存。归档天数取值范围：
V1：1~365天。仅按指标写入量支持。
V2：1~3650天（3650表示永久保存）
parameters.name: archive_duration

parameters.help_en: The authentication-free read policy. IP CIDR blocks and VPC IDs are supported
parameters.name: auth_free_read_policy

parameters.help_en: The authentication-free read policy. IP CIDR blocks and VPC IDs are supported
parameters.name: auth_free_write_policy

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable authentication-free read
parameters.name: enable_auth_free_read

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable authentication-free write
parameters.name: enable_auth_free_write

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable access token authentication
parameters.name: enable_auth_token

parameters.help_en: Instance storage database status of the instance. Only RUNNING is supported. If this parameter is left empty, instance storage database status remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 实例存储db状态（仅支持RUNNING）。为空时，不改变存储db状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The storage duration (days):
By write volume: 90 or 180.
By metric reporting volume: 15, 30, 60, 90, or 180
parameters.name: storage_duration

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. This parameter can be modified only once during the instance lifetime. Valid values:
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go by metric reporting volume.
POSTPAY_GB: pay-as-you-go by metric write volume
parameters.help_zh:
计费方式（实例的生命周期内，只能修改一次）：
POSTPAY：按指标上报量后付费。
POSTPAY_GB：按指标写入量后付费
parameters.name: payment_type

parameters.help_en: The workspace to which the instance belongs
parameters.name: workspace
